title: What the approved replay sample teaches us
summary: All 20 approved elite episodes were converted into 2,999 deterministic semantic decisions with an independently reproduced stream hash.
facts: An action stored at step t answers the same agent's active selection request at step t-1.
Replay actions use zero-based native option indices; they are not card IDs or semantic field values.
A STOP marker is reconstructed only when the submitted option count is below max_count.
The pregame firstPlayer value -1 means the opening player is not known yet and is normalized to missing.
The loader keeps one episode resident at a time and observed 64.546875 MiB peak RSS under a 256 MiB ceiling.
Execution order is retained for the 16 ordered requests, while transport position remains excluded from actor features.
boundaries: This is an elite, rating-selected and capped sample, not an unbiased ladder distribution.
Replay actions are available for diagnostics and meta understanding but are not authorized for imitation-learning supervision.
No additional replay retrieval is authorized by this gate closure.
